card.brief_text: Style Card test render: a brand-new design in this client's established look - pick a subject from their usual subject matter - with the text below.

reference_analysis.notes: Designed as a single-color (white ink) print on a dark garment. The black background should be treated as transparent/garment color. All shading and tonal values are achieved purely through varying the density and thickness of the white line work. No halftones are used.
reference_analysis.art_style: Vintage etching or scratchboard illustration, heavily detailed with fine line hatching and cross-hatching to create texture, fur, and shading. High rendering maturity, reminiscent of classic woodblock prints.
reference_analysis.composition: Center-aligned, tightly grouped vertical layout. The design is top-heavy with the illustration of the calf seamlessly interacting with the large title text 'HOME' in the center. The secondary script text sits immediately below to anchor the block, followed by the small, centered social handle at the very bottom.
reference_analysis.subject_structure: The central hero subject is a fluffy Highland cow calf depicted from the chest up. It features long, shaggy hair with distinctive locks draping over its forehead, fuzzy ears protruding horizontally, and a detailed snout. The calf's two front legs are visible, with detailed cloven hooves positioned as if resting directly on top of the large letters of the word 'HOME' below, making the text act as a physical ledge. The artwork relies entirely on intricate white lines and negative space.
reference_analysis.typography_transcription: The primary word 'HOME' is in a large, bold, western or circus-style slab serif font featuring scalloped, decorative serifs and internal vertical line hatching that gives a textured, 3D wood-carved appearance. Beneath it, 'is where your herd is' is written in a smooth, flowing, casual cursive script font. The bottom social handle '@TheHappyHourFarm' is set in a simple, clean, modern sans-serif font.
